content_sections.text: Qualification required: Graduation Degree from a recognized institution/University with minimum 50% Marks; B. Ed. (Special Education) with atleast 50% marks; OR B. Ed. (General) with atleast 50% marks alongwith one year/two years Diploma in Special Education or Post Graduate Professional Diploma in Special Education (PGPD) or Post graduate professional Certificate in Special Education (PGPC); OR PG Diploma in Special Education (Mental Retardation / Multiple Disability / Locomotor impairment and Cerebral Palsy); OR Secondary Level Teacher Training Course in Visual Impairment; OR Senior Diploma in Teaching the Deaf; OR B.A.B. Age limit: Maximum 65 years. Pay: ₹26,250. Qualification required: B.E./B.Tech./M.Tech. in Electronics & Communication Engineering. Experience required: Desirable - Minimum one year of experience in the relevant field, but fresher can apply. Age limit: 18 to 65 years. Pay: As per KVS Norms. Qualification required: A Three-year Diploma in Electrical or Electronics Engineering after 10+2 from a government-recognized institution/university, OR A Degree / Graduate Degree in Electrical or Electronics Engineering (EEE) with at least 50% marks. Experience required: Desirable - Minimum one year of experience in the relevant field, but fresher can apply. Age limit: 18 to 65 years. Pay: As per KVS Norms.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: As per KVS Norms for Vocational/WET Instructor. Engagement is contractual up to 31.03.2027. Does not confer any right to regular appointment.

faq.answer: The last date is 27 November 2026.

faq.answer: It depends on the post - TGT (Special Educator): maximum 65 years; Vocational Instructor: 18 to 65 years; WET Instructor: 18 to 65 years. Relaxation: SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD Relaxation up to 5 percent in the qualifying marks for CTET..

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?

faq.answer: Graduation Degree with minimum 50% Marks and B.Ed (Special Education) or equivalent, along with CTET Paper II and RCI registration. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.answer: Yes. Proficiency to teach in Hindi and English is required for TGT Special Educator. Working knowledge of Hindi and English is desirable.

faq.answer: Registration on KVS Samvida Sathi Portal. Interview and practical assessment. Selection may include an interview and practical assessment.
